dish.title: Japanese Chicken Nanban with Tartar Sauce, Shredded Cabbage, and Rice
dish.description: Boneless chicken thighs dredged in flour and egg, shallow-fried golden, then dipped in a sweet-sour nanban sauce of rice vinegar, soy sauce, and sugar and topped with a chunky tartar sauce of boiled egg, mayonnaise, sweet pickle relish, onion, parsley, and lemon, served with shredded cabbage and short-grain rice.

recipe_version.title: Japanese Chicken Nanban with Tartar Sauce, Shredded Cabbage, and Rice
recipe_version.description: Boneless chicken thighs dredged in flour and egg, shallow-fried golden, then dipped in a sweet-sour nanban sauce of rice vinegar, soy sauce, and sugar and topped with a chunky tartar sauce of boiled egg, mayonnaise, sweet pickle relish, onion, parsley, and lemon, served with shredded cabbage and short-grain rice.

ingredients.name: large eggs
ingredients.note: 2 boiled for tartar, 2 beaten for the coating

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: for shallow-frying, about 1/4 inch deep in the 12-inch skillet

ingredients.name: mayonnaise
ingredients.display_name: mayonnaise whose label lists oil, egg, vinegar, salt, and sugar

ingredients.name: sweet pickle relish
ingredients.display_name: sweet pickle relish whose label lists cucumbers, sugar, vinegar, salt, and spices

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Pound the thighs to an even 1/2 inch and season with 1 tsp salt. Mince the onion, chop the parsley, finely shred the cabbage, and rinse the rice until the rinse runs clear.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: While you make the eggs, sauces, and chicken (overlap stated): combine the rice and 1 3/4 cups water in a lidded 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil over high, about 4 minutes, then cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes. Leave it covered off the heat to rest 10 minutes.

steps.title: Boil 2 eggs
steps.body: Bring 4 cups water to a boil in the other 2-quart saucepan over high, about 6 minutes to come to a boil. Lower in 2 eggs, simmer 10 minutes, then cool under the cold tap for 2 minutes and peel.

steps.title: Tartar sauce
steps.body: Chop the boiled eggs and fold them with the mayonnaise, relish, onion, parsley, lemon juice, and 1/4 tsp salt.

steps.title: Nanban sauce
steps.body: Bring the vinegar, soy sauce, and sugar to a simmer in the 1-quart saucepan and simmer until the sugar dissolves, about 1 minute. Pour into a shallow dish.

steps.title: Shallow-fry
steps.body: Heat the oil (about 1/4 inch deep) in the 12-inch heavy skillet over medium to 340 F, about 5 minutes. Put the flour in one shallow dish and beat the remaining 2 eggs in the other. Dredge 2 thighs in flour, dip in egg, and shallow-fry until golden and 175 F, about 5 minutes per side. Drain on the rack and repeat (2 batches).

steps.title: Dip and serve
steps.body: Turn each hot thigh in the nanban sauce, slice it, and lay it beside a mound of cabbage and rice. Spoon the tartar sauce over the chicken.

equipment: wire rack set on a sheet pan
